name: agent-engineering-standards
source_of_truth_policy: Reusable standards and skills live in AI Global Tools shared paths. Repo-local files may reference this pack but must not duplicate it.

files.responsibility: version, inventory, canonical path, owners, consumers, update metadata
Exa research workflow, evidence expectations, fail-closed behavior
concise implementation rules for coding agents
review checklist for architecture, boundaries, tests, APIs, migrations, state, exceptions
file placement, artifacts, cleanup, source-of-truth drift
bounded exception process and human escalation

update_rules.patch: Clarifications that do not change obligations.
update_rules.minor: New guidance or role checklists that remain backward-compatible.
update_rules.major: Breaking standards, new mandatory gates, or changed source-of-truth layout requiring human approval.

non_authority: no hard-blocking enforcement without separate approval
